['INEOS Styrolution Holding GmbH '].company_description: INEOS Styrolution Holding GmbH is a European multinational company and the largest chemical producer in the world. Its headquarters are located in Ludwigshafen, Germany. The company operates in more than 80 countries and supplies products to a wide variety of industries. It has customers in over 190 countries and offers a diverse range of chemical products.

['Auto1.com Group GmbH '].company_description: AUTO1 Group SE operates as Europe's largest wholesale platform for car trading professionals through its merchant brand, AUTO1.com. It also operates the retail brand Autohero, providing consumers with an online car buying experience. The company is active in over 30 countries and has recently completed the first wave of its pan-European used car production network.
